items.summary: Our tech infrastructure is riddled with problems. But they’re all downstream of the incentives baked into shareholder capitalism It’s been a bad week for our computerized infrastructure. We’ve seen outages at Microsoft , the FAA , a handful of banks , United Airlines , an unnamed classified NSA network , and Apple . People should be forgiven for suspecting a coordinated cyber-attack, a common cause, or at least a conspiracy. But there is none. The incidents are unrelated. They’re not the result of any cyber-attack, coordinated or not. And, even more surprising, they don’t seem to be the result of AI. She did so despite raising less than $100,000 and receiving zero investment from the national party. Liz Landers spoke with Broderick about her win.

items.title: 'Huna' wins National Book Award, but author denied visa to attend ceremony
items.summary: At the National Book Awards, Abdelrahman ElGendy won the nonfiction prize for his book "Huna," a memoir of his six years as a political prisoner in Egypt. But ElGendy wasn't there to accept the award. His visa to travel from Europe was denied by the U.S. government. Amna Nawaz spoke with ElGendy for our arts and culture series, CANVAS.

items.title: Price tag for US war in Iran barrels past $48 billion
items.summary: A Pentagon budget officer has said the price of the Iran war surpassed $48.3 billion last week. That does not include costs sustained in Iranian attacks on US bases — lawmakers want details the Pentagon is loath to give.

items.title: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
items.summary: The investigation by California Attorney General Rob Bonta comes on the heels of the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: House music pioneer Crystal Waters celebrates the genre's influence and impact
items.summary: In New York, house music pioneer Crystal Waters is bringing together major figures like Deborah Cox and Billy Porter with a live orchestra. It's all to celebrate the genre's 30-year legacy. Geoff Bennett spoke with Waters about "I Am House Orchestrated" and how the music has grown into both a cultural revolution and a space for self-expression. It's for our arts and culture series, CANVAS.
